svg.title: BatchNorm, LayerNorm, GroupNorm and InstanceNorm differ only in which cells are averaged together
svg.desc: Four copies of a block of two images, each a grid of four channels by six positions; the cells that share one mean and variance are shaded: one channel across both images, one position of one image, a channel group of one image, one channel of one image.

g.text: one per token: its C features
the shaded cells are averaged together; a learned scale and shift per channel (or per feature) follow in every case
